# SME AI Impact Showcase — Singapore 2026
> Independent, evidence-graded case study library and open dataset covering the 30 winners of the inaugural Singapore SME AI Impact Awards 2026, organised by the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and Singapore Business Federation (SBF). Researched and maintained by Ivan Wong at BestCourses.sg.

## Overview
- **Awards Scope**: Inaugural national awards announced at SMEs Go Digital Day on 13 October 2026, selected from 290 nominations across 21 industry sectors.
- **Winners**: 30 distinct Singapore SMEs: 15 in Innovation Excellence (developed proprietary AI) and 15 in Adoption Excellence (implemented commercial ready-to-use AI tools).
- **Benchmark Context**: In 2025, national Singapore SME AI adoption surged to 23.4% (up from 14.5% in 2024), with 87.6% reporting productivity benefits and 44% reporting cost reduction (IMDA Singapore Digital Economy Report 2025).
- **Researcher & Attribution**: Researched and curated by Ivan Wong (Founder, BestCourses.sg; former Google Partners Trainer). This is an independent research project not affiliated with or endorsed by IMDA, SBF, or any winning company.

## Methodology & Evidence Rigor
Every case study evaluates public claims against an evidentiary hierarchy:
- **T0 (Canonical Source)**: Official IMDA and SBF award citations published on `https://smesgodigital.gov.sg/web/sme-ai-awards`.
- **T1-SUBMITTED (Primary Verified Telemetry)**: Architecture blueprints, production system logs, and paired operational metrics supplied directly by the implementing company or partner and reviewed.
- **T1 (Direct Primary Sources)**: Corporate newsrooms, government publications, and verified company portals.
- **T2 (Implementation Partners)**: Disclosed software vendors and solution providers.
- **T3 (Independent External Corroboration)**: Mainstream press (e.g. The Straits Times, Business Times), trade journals, and third-party audits.

### Cohort Architecture
The showcase is structured across three distinct collections:
1. **Award Cohort 2026**: The 30 inaugural winners of the SME AI Impact Awards (IMDA & SBF). Sealed and frozen.
2. **Practitioner Cases**: Production implementations delivered by Maple Commerce / Ivan Wong. Every surface carries a prominent conflict-of-interest disclosure; documentation depth sets the benchmark with complete architecture, model choices, and paired baselines.
3. **Community Cases**: Non-award Singapore SMEs meeting the 6-month production tenure threshold and verified via primary documentation.

### Evidence Grades
- **Grade A (Independently Supported)**: Claims corroborated by at least one independent third-party source outside the winning company and citation, or fully verified primary telemetry (T1-SUBMITTED).
- **Grade B (Canonical Source Supported)**: Verified and grounded strictly in the official IMDA/SBF award citation and direct corporate records.
- **Grade C (Limited Public Evidence)**: Thin public record where architectural details remain proprietary or undisclosed.

### Research Coverage Scoring
Scored 0–100% across 10 evaluation dimensions: Company Profile, Business Challenges, Named AI Solution, Solution Components, Named Vendors, Documented Workflow, Quantified Outcomes, Independent Corroboration, Governance Controls, and Implementation Timeline.
